To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the pre service teachers in the study had positive attitude towards online learning and they were willing to use online learning in the future.
the pre service teachers have moderate level of acceptance toward the use of an e learning platform in a social science education subject.
the pre service teachers have moderate level of acceptance of e learning in the observed social science course via the technology acceptance model.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the behavior of preservice teachers towards the use of e-learning in a social science course via technology acceptance model (TAM).
the use of e-learning in a Malaysian context.
the use of e Learning as a teaching medium to support the learning process in the context of social science subject in a public university.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
pre service teachers perceived the use of elearning to be useful and easy to use, and they were satisfied and intended to use it in their future career as teachers.
the technology acceptance model (TAM) is a useful model to predict the intention to use e learning in the social science subject.
the technology acceptance model is useful to understand the acceptance of e learning by teachers.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of e Learning in social science education can be a good strategy in improving the quality of teaching and learning process in Malaysia.
we need to understand the factors that affect the acceptance and use of technology in the classroom.

e learning can be used to improve the quality of education in Malaysia, especially in social science subjects, but the quality of e learning depends on the design, pedagogy and navigation of a course.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is important to design a learning environment that is user friendly and easy to navigate, and that the learning environment is perceived as useful by the students.
the design of a course and the way it is presented to users can be crucial in determining the success of a learning management system.
we have demonstrated that a combination of the technology acceptance model and the social cognitive theory can be applied to the context of e learning in higher education.
